explanation: It mixed blues, ragtime and brass-band music. Louis Armstrong, born there in 1901, learned the cornet in a home for boys and later played on Mississippi riverboats.

claims.text: Jazz developed in New Orleans in the early 20th century.
Chicago, Kansas City and St. Louis were not the birthplace of jazz, though jazz later flourished in some of them.
Early jazz drew on blues, ragtime and brass-band music.
Louis Armstrong was born in New Orleans in 1901.
Armstrong learned the cornet at the Waif's Home for boys in New Orleans.
Armstrong later played in bands on Mississippi riverboats.

issues.note: Armstrong's birth year is disputed in older sources (his own date was 4 July 1900; the baptismal record gives 4 August 1901). The explanation's 1901 matches the current record, but a player who learned 1900 may report it. Consider 'born there' without the year.
